articles.summary: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo., May 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Central Bancompany, Inc. (Nasdaq: CBC) (“Central Bancompany” or “the Company”), the bank holding company for The Central Trust Bank, will release its second quarter 2026 financial results before market hours on Tuesday, August 4, 2026.
